purpose: Provide executable fixture-local supplied air-data kinematics with explicit frames, sample identity, domains and unclamped angular definitions.

provenance.notes: The Scientific Authority accepted the fixture-local relative-velocity identity, body axes, passive transform, alpha/beta definitions, strict singular domains and absence of Legacy clamps. The bundle has no product or Legacy dependency.

expected_facts.claim: Independent 80-digit Decimal and C++17 implementations agree on wind subtraction, passive inertial-to-body rotation, speed, alpha, beta, dynamic pressure and Mach number.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Frame, body-axis, clock and sample identities are exact; finite formula values use the fixture-local absolute-plus-relative tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: Quaternion sign and a common inertial velocity offset leave every physical air-data result unchanged.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Equivalence identities are exact; physical values use the fixture-local formula tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: The executable rejects inconsistent identity, non-finite input, invalid quaternion, invalid atmosphere, zero speed and pure lateral singularity while detecting four sign, direction and clamp mutations.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Rejection and mutation identities are exact; no tolerance repairs an out-of-domain input.

acceptance: The bundle records formula inputs, quaternion intermediates, physical outputs, exact sample identity, equivalence checks and direct domain failures
The Python reference and C++17 probe share no implementation and neither imports product or Legacy code
Canonical environment, sensor, aerodynamic validity and product contracts remain outside this fixture-local slice
